latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic assignment and saved the artifacts before completing the native Goal.

- [critique.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M02-B/treatment/critic/critique.md) contains the six-clause review, material and minor findings, and proposed validation gaps.
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M02-B/treatment/critic/source-map.json) and [sources/README.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M02-B/treatment/critic/sources/README.md) index 11 independently inspected primary sources and their evidence notes.

The review highlights the distinction between recurring patterns and reusable templates in [Better Impact’s guide](https://support.betterimpact.com/en/articles/8780736-comprehensive-guide-to-activities), explicit priority and response-status handling for the [Google scheduling API](https://developers.google.com/optimization/service/reference/rest/v1/scheduling/solveShiftScheduling), and clearer time-zone and reminder-accessibility validation. It also corroborates the bounded [Timefold PR #2596](https://github.com/TimefoldAI/timefold-solver/pull/2596) release chain.

No product, API, solver, or accessibility witness was run. The separate reviser pass is not claimed because the assignment prohibits nested agents. The native Goal is complete; usage was 184,326 tokens over 9m50s.
